Name: Master Tackle
Author: bybyku98
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Instant Perfect Catch:[/b] Equipping the [b]Master Tackle[/b] bypasses the fishing minigame completely. As soon as a fish bites, you instantly reel it in with a guaranteed Perfect status![/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Balanced & Configurable:[/b] Comes with customizable crafting difficulty options via [b]config.json [/b][/color][color=#D4D4D8]so you can tailor the recipe to your preferred level of progression.[/color]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip the [b]Master Tackle[/b] mod folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the [/color]MasterTackle [color=#D4D4D8]folder into your [/color]Stardew Valley/Mods [color=#D4D4D8]directory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game using SMAPI![/color]


This mod is still in development, this is not the final version there will be changes.


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[b]SMAPI[/b] v4.0.0+
